doc.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023

title: First studio work: jingles in Dallas
summary: He began recording jingles twice a week in Dallas while at North Texas State, doing eight to ten commercials an hour.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Do you recall the first time you put on headphones in the studio setting to record something and make a few dollars?

Wow. I started recording in Dallas when I was in college at North Texas State. Somehow somebody got my name and I started going into Dallas twice a week to record on jingles with the top professionals there in town. It was — we would do eight or ten commercials during a one-hour session. That means you don’t have time to practice the part. You have to be able to read it perfectly the first time or they’ll throw you out and get somebody else for the next session.
